temporal_methods.label: Schedule-Aligned Traversal (+5m Base)
temporal_methods.description: Maps hourly OD volume onto active GTFS scheduled train departures along the unique physical path. Reconciles empirical KTMB ticketing differences: Klang Valley AFC tap-out timestamps align primarily via latest arrival within 90m before exit tap (+ bounded pre-departure QR/token fallback), while Komuter Utara gate/ticket timestamps align forward to earliest departure >= t_tx + 5m. Downstream crossings shift into the exact clock hour trains traverse each segment (handling >=24:00:00 trips).

temporal_methods.label: Tight Schedule Sensitivity (0m Buffer)
temporal_methods.description: Zero-minute boarding buffer sensitivity testing sensitivity of boundary-minute trips vs +5m base.

temporal_methods.label: Transaction-Hour Baseline (Diagnostic)
temporal_methods.description: Projects raw OD volume instantaneously along all path segments in the transaction clock hour without travel-time propagation or train departure matching.

capacity_modes.label: Official 2023 Rate Card Nominal (1,118 KV / 400 Utara)
capacity_modes.description: KTMB ETS-REDCARD (2023) total seated + standing nominal capacity per scheduled trainset.

capacity_modes.label: 80% Planning Comfort Sensitivity (894 KV / 320 Utara)
capacity_modes.description: Derived 80% load comfort sensitivity benchmark; never presented as physical measurement or official regulation.

formulas.scheduled_capacity: S = N * C (scheduled segment train crossings N in clock hour * nominal train capacity C)
formulas.load_ratio_pct: Load Ratio (%) = (D / S) * 100 when S > 0; null when S == 0 (never zero-divided)
formulas.additional_trains_needed: Extra Trains = ceil(Deficit / C) == max(0, ceil(D / C) - N) per individual segment-hour (never summed across adjacent segments)
formulas.station_conservation: D_in - A + B == D_out; Remaining = max(0, S_out - T); Boarding Gap = max(0, B - Remaining); Upstream Full Flag = (T > S_out)

stat_aggregations.mean: Average peak-hour load across all calendar dates in the selected Day Profile & Period slice (including lower-demand days).
stat_aggregations.p90: 90th percentile daily peak segment load ratio / deficit across observed dates in slice.
stat_aggregations.max_date: Single highest observed date-hour overload within the selected slice (surface-checks event & holiday surges such as Deepavali).
